brief_summary: Patients will be enrolled and randomly assigned to either the test group or the control group for short-time intensive insulin therapy in inpatient setting. The test group will receive treatment with the Insulin Patch Pump System, while the control group will be treated with the Medtronic MMT-1805 insulin pump (MiniMed 700). The treatment period will last 7 days, during which blood glucose monitoring will be conducted in both groups.
brief_title: To Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of the Insulin Patch Pump System in Patients With Diabetes.

lead_sponsor.name: Suzhou Hechun Medical Technology Co., Ltd.

official_title: To Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of the Insulin Patch Pump System in Patients With Diabetes: A Prospective, Randomized, Positive Parallel Controlled, Open-label, Multicenter, Non-inferiority Clinical Trial.

primary_outcomes.measure: Change in mean blood glucose from baseline(Day 0) to Day 7
primary_outcomes.time_frame: Compare the difference in the change of mean blood glucose from baseline (Day 0) to Day 7 between the two groups
